subject: Competitive bake-off recap & next steps
summary: Post-call recap of the competitive bake-off discussion with Omniva Health. Confirms pain points (latency at scale, multitenant data isolation, cost predictability), decision criteria, proposed test plan, and next steps including a 2-week technical bake-off with test dataset and success metrics.
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lina Herrera <lina.h@omniva.com>; Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@omniva.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Competitive bake-off recap & next steps

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the candid conversation. Quick recap of what we heard and the plan we discussed so we all stay aligned.

Pain points you highlighted:
- Latency spikes during end-of-day reporting (> 1s token latency) that impact customer workflows
- Unpredictable per-token costs when traffic bursts occur
- Need for private deployment options for PHI-sensitive pipelines (VPC/on-prem considerations)

Decision criteria you mentioned:
1) Sustained p95 latency under 350ms for common prompts (seq len ~512)
2) Clear unit economics at 1M tokens/mo and headroom for bursts
3) Private deployment with KMS integration and SOC 2 evidence
4) Easy model variant fallbacks to maintain availability

Competitive positioning (high level):
- Redwood: unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private, autoscaling with predictable throughput, built-in KV caching and prefix reuse — proposed to run an initial 2-week bake-off with your test set.
- HyperServe (competitor): strong latency for short prompts but less mature private deployment tooling we saw in the RFP.
- CloudLlama: good cost at high batch sizes but latency variability for low-concurrency interactive flows.

Open questions we agreed to capture:
- Exact test dataset sampling method (you suggested 10k representative requests from last 30 days)
- Whether we can run private demo in your staging VPC or if you prefer Redwood-hosted dedicated capacity for the tests
- Any hard constraints on peak memory (GPU footprint) for on-prem images

Proposed next steps:
- Marissa/Rachel: share bake-off test plan and comparison matrix by EOD Monday (attached)
- Omniva: confirm dataset export and point of contact for credentials (Carlos?)
- Tech eval: agree success metrics and scoring rubric (latency, cost, functional parity)
- Schedule kickoff: week of 6/21 for a 2-week technical bake-off

Attachments: redwood-vs-competitors-matrix.pdf, bakeoff-test-plan.xlsx

If any of this looks off, flag here and I’ll update. Otherwise I’ll assume we proceed with the plan and will send the formal invite for the kickoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198
